Blocked by lazy-harness PreToolUse: unsafe git stash (scope).
Why: `git stash pop` removes the entry it applies, and the one on top may belong to another session.
The stash stack is shared across every worktree of this repository and across concurrent sessions.
Instead: prefer a temporary WIP commit. If you must stash, use
  git stash push -u -m "<unique-tag>"
then restore with `git stash apply <sha>` and drop that entry by ref.
If this is intentional, add a regex to [hooks.pre_tool_use_git_scope] allow_patterns in your profile config.toml.
